records.title: Deep Learning on Mobile and Embedded Devices
records.reason: Retain as borderline only because on-device compression, quantization, and inference frameworks could inform edge LLM deployment. Official ACM full-text/PDF retrieval failed, so its exact treatment of language models and relevance could not be confirmed.

records.title: WebLINX: Real-World Website Navigation with Multi-Turn Dialogue
records.reason: Borderline because browser-agent contexts can affect LLM serving cost, and the paper quantifies large HTML/token burdens. However, the contribution is a dataset/benchmark, not an inference optimization; keep only as context for future agent-serving comparisons.

records.title: MolmoAct: Action Reasoning Models that can Reason in Space
records.reason: The full text identifies latency and reasoning-token overhead in VLA control but does not provide a concrete reduction method or measured serving improvement. Keep borderline as a problem statement/application only.

records.title: Building and better understanding vision-language models: insights and future directions
records.reason: Retain borderline because visual tokens directly affect multimodal LLM inference prefill work, but the source synthesizes design choices and tradeoffs without a new method or controlled serving-cost result.

records.title: Graph-Mamba: Towards Long-Range Graph Sequence Modeling with Selective State Spaces
records.reason: The primary abstract targets large graphs and graph sequence tasks; it does not evaluate a language model or serving path.
